 Palo Alto Mayor's Tree Planting
Palo Alto Mayor's Tree Planting
Saturday, October 3, 2026
 @ 
9:00 am
 - 
10:00 am
Palo Alto Art Center, 1313 Newell Rd, Palo Alto, CA 94303, USA
Register: No registration required
Join Palo Alto Mayor Vicki Veenker, Canopy, Sibling Cities USA, and community members for a simultaneous tree planting connecting Palo Alto with its Sibling City, Bloomington, Indiana.
At the same moment, more than 2,000 miles apart, the two cities will plant matching Canadian redbud trees. The ceremonies will be connected by livestream, creating a living symbol of friendship, collaboration, and what communities can accomplish when we grow together.
Free and open to the public.
See more details
 Celebrating Canopy Champions: 2026 Volunteer Appreciation and Tree Awards
Celebrating Canopy Champions: 2026 Volunteer Appreciation and Tree Awards
Saturday, October 3, 2026
 @ 
3:00 pm
 - 
5:00 pm
All Five, 1391 Chilco St, Menlo Park, CA 94025, USA
Register: 
RSVP Here
On October 3rd, please join Canopy for our annual Volunteer Appreciation and Tree Awards! At this free community celebration, we will honor our 2026 Canopy Tree Awardees and you – our volunteers, partners, and supporters who dig in to champion our urban forests and communities. Hosted at All Five Preschool, festivities will include outdoor mingling, food and refreshments, interactive displays to honor our volunteers throughout the years, and a brief program recognizing our 2026 Tree Awardees.
